channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
item.description: After its own AI usage wake-up call, Rippling this week unveiled AI Spend Console, a product that tracks individual and team employee AI spending.

item.title: Wacom’s Movinkpad 11 is a fun and mid-priced entry point for digital artists
item.description: The Movinkpad 11 a versatile little graphics tablet that can help make your wildest digital art dreams come true.

item.title: Could this be the end of BIOS-locked laptops? AI tweaker deploys Claude to unlock and change settings for good
item.description: AI helps patch a signature check to always say "yes" on a specific HP laptop using a hardware flasher.

item.title: Security researchers scanned the Polish web and found courts, hospitals, and airports at risk of hacks
item.description: Researchers found common points of failure, like software used to organize and display web content, could have allowed hackers to run riot through government websites.

item.title: WhatsApp scam costs Hong Kong man $1.27 million after criminals used AI voice notes to impersonate his father — experts say secret codewords are the best way to stay safe
item.description: Scammers used AI to steal $1.27 million from a Hong Kong man as experts say a secret codeword can keep you safe.

item.title: 'I wasn’t driving. I had Autopilot on': Tesla’s Full Self-Driving system is getting drivers speeding tickets, and owners aren’t happy
item.description: Tesla's autonomous driving systems are getting drivers speeding tickets — but the law is having none of it.

item.title: The fight over Trump’s White House ballroom just took a dramatic turn
item.description: A federal appeals court halted construction while the administration prepares its next legal move Trump’s controversial plan to build an enormous ballroom adjacent to – and larger than – the White House just ground to a halt.

item.title: Our top-rated business PC is a multitasking powerhouse — save $530 on the Dell Tower Plus with Core Ultra 7
item.description: Our top-rated desktop computer for professionals comes with Intel Core Ultra 7 265, Nvidia RTX 5060 Ti, 32GB DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB NVMe SSD.

item.title: Hivemind AI software carries out first on-water 'swarming test' in Taiwan mission
item.description: Hivemind autonomously directed Thunder Tiger drone boats through Taiwan's first coordinated maritime swarming exercise, expanding autonomous defence capabilities at sea.

item.title: Fenix Flexin isn’t even denying using AI to make ‘Rubberz’ anymore
item.description: It took long enough, but now LA rapper Fenix Flexin appears to have admitted using AI for the 80s synth pop-themed song "Rubberz." His comments follow the producer Medasin's videos claiming that an AI tool called Treblo (formerly Sonauto) was used to make the song, and the company releasing an AI detector that identifies it […]
